title: Drag the words (H5P.DragText)
description: A short text with gaps the learner fills by dragging words. Write each gap as {1}, {2}, … in the text and list the words in the same order. Every word must appear in the cited source text.

instruction.description: One sentence telling the learner what to do

text.description: A paragraph of the lesson with placeholders {1}, {2}, … where the draggable words go

answer.description: The word that belongs in the gap, without * : /

tip.description: A hint that does not give the answer away; empty for none

distractors.description: Up to 4 wrong words that look plausible; may be empty
